description: This file defines the Alert data structure and related functions for handling alerts in the Prometheus monitoring system, including alert status, validation, and sorting.

classes.name: Alert
classes.description: Represents an alert with labels, annotations, timing, and URL.

methods.name: Name
methods.description: Returns the alert's name, derived from the 'alertname' label.

methods.name: Fingerprint
methods.description: Returns a unique hash for the alert based on its labels.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Provides a string representation of the alert, including its name, fingerprint, and status.

methods.name: Resolved
methods.description: Checks if the alert has ended in the past.

methods.name: ResolvedAt
methods.description: Checks if the alert ended before a specific timestamp.

methods.name: Status
methods.description: Returns the current status of the alert.

methods.name: StatusAt
methods.description: Returns the status of the alert at a specific timestamp.

methods.name: Validate
methods.description: Validates the alert data for consistency.
